newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu arrives for Hebron summit with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu arrives for Hebron summit with Arafat.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyhau arrived at the Israel-Gaza border for a U.S.-brokered meeting on Tuesday with Yasser Arafat in a bid to seal a deal on a long-overdue troop pullback from Hebron.

Witnesses said Netanyahu made no comments to reporters as he arrived for the meeting, his first with the Palestinian leader since President Bill Clinton called an emergency White House summit following fierce Israeli-Palestinian gun battles last September.
